If you ever crash on our world again, it would be less painful to die in the crash than to fall into our hands.|[[Fassool]] and [[Eron Stonefield]]|<ref name="TT" />}}
'''Togoria''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]].

==Geography==
{{Quote|Togoria's a pretty world. I wouldn't mind seeing it again.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Bria Tharen]]|<ref name="RD">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref>}}
Togoria was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with grassy plains, dense forests and rolling hills. it was the homeworld of the feline [[Togorian/Legends|Togorians]], tall, furry creatures who were suspicious of offworlders.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Foreigners were not permitted on the planet uninvited, unless they crashed (crashing was only allowed once).

[[File:Mosgoth.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] riding his [[mosgoth]].]]
The government was headed by a male hereditary monarch, the [[Margrave/Legends|Margrave]] of Togoria.<ref name="CSWE" />

Togorian society was still relatively low-tech and based on solar technology. Togoria's vast mineral resources were left largely untapped.<ref name="CSWE" />

==History==
{{Quote|On Togoria, the mighty rule. Might is law. This way is best.|[[Fassool]], to [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]|<ref name="TT" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Togoria voluntarily joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was the site of a [[Battle of Togoria (Clone Wars)|battle]] where the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] was trapped and defeated.<ref name="Grievous">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref>

For a period of time, it also was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] world.

In [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Bria Tharen]] went to Togoria to attend the [[Wedding of Muuurgh and Mrrov|wedding]] of Togorian lovers [[Muuurgh]] and [[Mrrov]] after escaping the [[Cult of The One and The All]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref> [[0 ABY/Legends|Ten years later]], a group of Togorians assisted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] in the [[Battle of Ylesia|attack]] of this sect.<ref name="RD" />

===Galactic Civil War===
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] disabled the [[Punishing One/Legends|''Punishing One'']] in the [[Thanos system]]. Its occupants, [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[Udin]], and [[Eron Stonefield]], had planned to capture Solo and claim the large [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head. But the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were forced to use an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to reach Togoria. The ''Falcon'' landed in the city of [[Caross]] with its passengers: [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The [[Margrave-sister]], [[Ffaseer effet Ihsss]], met with Leia, and invites her and her companions to a royal reception. Meanwhile, the bounty hunters also landed on Togoria. In the forests of the planet, they were set upon by [[Fassool]]'s [[Mindnight Fire clan|hunting band]] who eventually agreed to help him find and capture Solo. The bounty hunters made their way to Caross and subdued the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. Dengar decided to turn the rebels to a [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]], the [[Valiant (Victory-class)|''Valiant'']]. But the ''Valiant'', however, had been overrun by Rebel forces. The bounty hunters unwittingly delivered the Rebels to other Rebels masquerading as Imperials, collecting counterfeit [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SbS" />

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Togoria had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The planet later joined [[High Admiral]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Teradoc]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] made a costly [[Battle of Togoria (Galactic Civil War)|victory]] in the system but Togoria stayed in the [[Greater Maldrood]]. It was definitely [[Battle of Thanos|liberated]] [[8 ABY/Legends|three years later]], during the [[Post–Zsinj campaigns]].<ref name="TEA" />

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
During the early [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet was [[Battle of the Thanos system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="TEA" /> Togorian slaves, among others, were encountered by the [[Myrkr strike team]] led by [[Anakin Solo]] on the [[Koros-Strohna]] ''[[Baanu Rass]]'' in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Togoria in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
